_what: The shared closed-loop episode set. Every policy compared in one table must run exactly these, because the score is dominated by how far the start is (corr(d_start, improvement) = 0.66 over 138 held-out rollouts).
_contract: A MANIFEST, not a rule. Regenerating this file redefines the comparison and makes earlier numbers incomparable — add a new version instead of editing this one.
_verify: Recompute d_start from start_pose/goal_pose/subject_center/subject_height via reward.pose_to_geometry + _geometry_distance and refuse to run if it differs by more than 1e-6. That check is what proves two repos ran the same shots.
